title: Russian Grain Lobby Says Kyiv's Attacks Threaten Black Sea Exports
summary_full: Russia, the world's largest wheat exporter, and Ukraine, also a major agricultural exporter, have been attacking each other's agricultural export facilities and commercial vessels in the Black Sea area in recent weeks.
